ABOUT THE HOME
Welcome to 30A Born 2 Beach, a spectacular modern coastal estate in Blue Mountain Beach designed for guests who appreciate luxury, space, and unforgettable gatherings. This newly constructed home is as impressive as it is inviting, offering the perfect setting for multi-family vacations, reunions, retreats, celebrations, and special events along 30A.

From the moment you arrive, you’ll see that this home was designed for entertaining. The expansive backyard oasis features a resort-style pool with tanning shelf, swim-up table, and spa, creating the perfect space for long sunny afternoons and evening swims under the stars. Surrounding the pool is a thoughtfully designed outdoor living area with shaded lounge seating, an outdoor TV, dining space, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen—ideal for hosting casual cookouts, poolside cocktails, or lively family dinners.

Step inside and the entertaining continues. The first floor features a recreation lounge complete with a poker table, sectional sofa, TV, and mini kitchen, creating the perfect hangout space for games, movie nights, or relaxing after a beach day. Two king suites and a spacious bunk room make this level comfortable for families traveling together, and the interior elevator provides easy access to all three floors.

The second floor is the heart of the home, showcasing an impressive chef’s kitchen built for gathering. Outfitted with a six-burner gas range with griddle, two dishwashers, two microwaves, and an oversized island with seating for seven, it’s perfect for preparing meals for large groups. Just beyond the kitchen, a beautiful balcony overlooks the backyard and pool, offering another inviting space for outdoor dining, lounging, and evening conversations.

This floor also includes two king bedrooms and another bunk room sleeping six, making it ideal for multi-family groups.

The third floor adds even more comfort and flexibility, with a mini kitchen, front and back balconies, and four additional king bedrooms. With room to comfortably sleep up to 28 guests, this home was thoughtfully designed for large gatherings while still allowing everyone their own private retreat.

Whether you're planning a family reunion, corporate retreat, wedding celebration, or milestone gathering, 30A Born 2 Beach offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and unforgettable shared spaces.

ABOUT THE AREA
Blue Mountain Beach is one of the most beloved communities along Scenic Highway 30A, known for its laid-back coastal charm and family-friendly atmosphere. Nestled between Gulf Place and Grayton Beach, this community offers a quieter, more relaxed setting while still being close to restaurants, shops, and local attractions.

Spend your days exploring nearby beaches, biking scenic coastal trails, or enjoying local favorites like Blue Mountain Bakery, Red Fish Taco, and Blue Mabel. Blue Mountain is the perfect place to experience the beauty and relaxed pace that makes 30A so special.

BEACH ACCESS
The closest beach access is Gulfview Heights Beach Access, located approximately 1,800 feet from the home. This well-appointed access includes parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with covered seating, and lifeguards during peak season.

From the house, turn right onto 30A and left at Goatfeathers Seafood Restaurant onto Gulfview Heights Street. Follow the road straight to the beach.

Sleeps 28 | 10 Bedrooms

• Bedroom 1 – King with ensuite bath – 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 – King with ensuite bath – 1st Floor

• Bedroom 5 – King with ensuite bath & balcony – 2nd Floor

• Bedroom 8 – King with ensuite bath & front balcony – 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 9 – King with ensuite bath – 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 10 – King with ensuite bath & back balcony – 3rd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS
• Resort-style private backyard entertainment area
• Private Heated Pool & Spa with swim-up table (heating available for additional fee)
• Golf Cart Included
• Complimentary Adult Bicycles
• Outdoor kitchen with dining and lounge space
• Outdoor TV and shaded seating area
• Chef’s kitchen with 6-burner gas range and griddle
• Two dishwashers, microwaves, and coffee stations
• Indoor recreation lounge with poker table
• Two mini kitchens with refrigerator and microwave
• Two full-size washer & dryer sets
• Smart TVs throughout the home
• Elevator access to all floors
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Full linen package included
• Self check-in

PARKING
Parking available for 6 vehicles only. Parking on grass, neighboring property, or the street is not permitted.

HOUSE RULES
• Check-In: After 4 PM | Check-Out: 10 AM
• No smoking or vaping
• Renters must be 25 years of age or older
• Elevator use restricted to guests 18+ unless accompanied by an adult
• Internet speeds may vary during peak periods
• State and county taxes plus required fees apply
• Bikes and golf carts are not guaranteed to be present or operational
• Starter amenities are provided upon arrival

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL
All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement directly with Bonheur Vacations and verify identity through the Happy Stays app by uploading:

A government-issued photo ID

A selfie for verification.

This home also features exterior security cameras for property protection.

ABOUT BONHEUR VACATIONS
Bonheur Vacations is a female-founded, locally family-owned boutique vacation management company dedicated to delivering exceptional vacation experiences along Scenic Highway 30A and the Emerald Coast.

We specialize in hosting large family reunions, retreats, wedding gatherings, milestone celebrations, and multi-family vacations, pairing extraordinary homes with thoughtful hospitality and concierge services.

Our team can help elevate your stay with services such as private chefs, beach bonfires, event planning, in-home massages, yoga sessions, childcare, and celebration coordination—allowing you to focus on what matters most: spending time with the people you love.

When you choose Bonheur Vacations, you’re not simply booking a luxury home—you’re partnering with a local team committed to making your stay seamless, memorable, and truly extraordinary.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response: Thank you for staying with us and for sharing your feedback. We’re glad the home was clean and spacious for your family. We’re truly sorry about the internet and TV issues — we know how important that is, and we’ll be addressing it to prevent future interruptions. We appreciate your understanding and hope to host you again for a smoother stay.

reviews.text: House was clean and was big enough for our family. The bad news was there was no internet or proper tv for most of our trip….it really was the downer in our trip but overall all else was good.

reviews.author: Kasey N.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at this house, and it was more than large enough for our group of 18. The golf cart was not at the property the first day but was delivered first thing the next morning. It was great for going to and from the beach and dinner. The pool took several days to heat up, but once it did, the kids had a blast. The hot tub was great the entire time, so that kept them happy while we were waiting for the pool to heat. Overall, the host was very responsive any time we had a question and even offered us a late checkout for free. She also gave us a discounted rate if we return for another trip.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.label: Good
reviews.text: Bedrooms and bathrooms were outstanding. Elevator is a bonus for those not wishing to climb stairs. EV use was very convenient for getting to the beach. House appliances more than adequate and excellent. AC, fans, washer and dryer all excellent. Pool was loved by the kids. but for the price and luxuriousness of the property, the additional DAILY fee of 150 to heat either the pool or the hot tub was “cheap”.

reviews.label: Good
reviews.text: Need a book to tell you how to operate things in the home. Elevator did not work after day 1. Pool was heated before we got there so couldn’t use it til day 2. No info on how to operate pool/ hot tub. Second golf cart didn’t arrive til day 2. Shower head in bathroom was broke. They couldn’t fix til the day we were leaving. On the other hand we did get a late checkout that was nice! Would stay there again! Be sure to ask for golf cart waivers ahead of time otherwise you can’t get the key. No one had sent them to us
